ranking: Pooled out-of-time Brier on exactly the same events; tie-break log loss then identifier
secondary: Equal-day Brier, log loss, hit rate, ECE, fold stability; no retrospective switching of the primary metric
uncertainty: 10000 deterministic seeded day-cluster bootstrap replicates of paired loss differences; 95% and Bonferroni 1-0.05/15 intervals; diagnostic only after selection
limitations: Previously explored archive: exploratory comparison, not independent certification
All models share identical test IDs and chronological availability constraints
No automatic promotion or change of the frozen prospective cohort
No evidence of betting profit without an executable price benchmark
